title: Norman, OK — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Norman, OK: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Norman is a city in OK with a population of 128,000. Home of the University of Oklahoma with a vibrant college town and the National Weather Center. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.6.
